title: Agent harness: look on a result card throws in the bench (no storedLook fake), cases end on STEP_LIMIT
description: second-picture-room-every-editor, second-picture-character and outpaint-grows-one-side end on STEP_LIMIT ~1 in 3-9 runs: a plain look on a generated result throws 'this._tools.storedLook is not a function' (bench fakeTools lacks the per-card description store), the model reads TOOL_ERROR as a bad ref and guesses grp_1 / filename / raw path until the round limit. Fix: give fakeTools the store.
